query-aware, and usable by a frozen LLM without replaying the full history at inference time. Existing options each fail on one axis. Full-context prompting preserves fidelity but scales poorly in latency and KV cache. RAG and text-memory systems keep growing external stores and operate in discrete text space, which is good for exact recall but weak at abstracting evolving preferences. Per-user LoRA modifies the model itself and can interfere with general capabilities. Static prompt tuning is lightweight but too limited to express rich user state. LPM is designed to sit in between: store user history in a small latent memory, then convert that memory into input-conditioned soft prompts so the same frozen backbone can behave differently for different users and different queries.","importance":"Its value for foundation-model researchers is less about improving pretraining directly and more about defining a clean interface between a general model and persistent user memory. The method separates universal knowledge from user-specific state: the base model stays frozen, while personalization lives in a compact external latent representation. That is an important design choice if one cares about continual personalization, federated deployment, or avoiding contamination of the base model through per-user adaptation. It also broadens the notion of soft prompting. Instead of learning a static prompt per user, LPM generates prompts dynamically from the interaction between the current query and a user memory bank. Conceptually, this is closer to a learned memory read mechanism than to standard PEFT. It is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to the pretrain-to-deployment interface and to architectures for persistent memory.","technical_approach":"$36","experiments":"$37","reading_guide":"Read it as a memory-architecture paper, not as a generic PEFT paper. PTQ，位宽为INT4、INT3。核心结果：1）INT4/INT3量化在多数推理benchmark上最终答案准确率损失<2%（几乎无损），但CTIR可达1.15~1.4（推理token数增加15%~40%）；例如MoE模型的INT3量化在AIME25上准确率仅降0.3%，但CTIR达1.32。2）膨胀程度与任务推理强度正相关：轻推理的通用语言benchmark（HellaSwag、MMLU-Pro）的CTIR仅1.02~1.07，几乎无膨胀。3）行为层面：量化模型的推理轨迹中，语义重复片段占比提升8%~15%，中间验证步骤数量增加20%以上，这些额外步骤未带来正确率提升。4）缓解策略效果：prompt要求简洁仅在部分benchmark上降低CTIR，同时导致准确率下降3%~5%；解码硬截断推理长度会大幅降低正确率；QAT可将准确率损失控制在1%以内，同时将CTIR降到1.05以内，是当前最优的缓解方向。","reading_guide":"精读优先级：1）第4章的核心实验结果表格，重点对比不同模型、不同量化位宽、不同任务下的CTIR与准确率变化，这是全文的核心实证依据；2）第6章的行为分析部分，明确膨胀的具体表现是重复推理而非冗余措辞，理解其对计算成本的实际影响；3）第5章CTIR的定义与计算细节，注意推理token与答案token的拆分逻辑，避免后续复现或使用时出现指标偏差；4）第7章的缓解策略对比，重点分析QAT能同时控制精度损失和token膨胀的内在原因。可跳过附录中具体量化算法的参数配置细节（除非从事量化工程落地）。值得深挖的方向：推理模型的数值精度如何影响其“终止推理、输出答案”的决策阈值，是否可以在预训练、RL训练阶段引入推理长度正则化，来提升模型的量化鲁棒性，从训练源头降低部署时的隐藏成本。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"Existing The second is a deterministic regime: greedy decoding plus five activation-grafting variants. Activation grafting replaces the hidden state at the last prompt token with cheap synthetic vectors and then continues with greedy decoding. This keeps the prompt and weights fixed while perturbing the deterministic trajectory through the residual stream. The method is used as a diagnostic tool, not as a recommended deployment decoder. Starting from a high-quality reference response, the framework applies a controlled degradation to create a worse response, and defines the gold label as preferring the original reference. This produces pairwise items from any reference corpus without human annotation. The perturbations are designed to be language-agnostic, relying on whitespace tokens, sentence boundaries, and digit patterns. The repeat_pad perturbation is the verbosity-bias probe: it makes the degraded response longer while keeping it strictly worse, so a preference for the padded response indicates a length bias. 研究，它更偏评测基础设施，启发大于方法贡献。","technical_approach":"核心方法是构建一个可扩展的合成用户轨迹生成管线，而不是从现有聊天数据拼接历史。作者设计了 16 个 stateful apps 和 66 个 API，在这些环境中生成 15 个月的细粒度行为日志。关键点有四个。第一，事件不是独立采样，而是 event chain：同一个潜在意图会在多个月份、多个 app Its value for LLM research is in the post-training and RL environment design side. Many tool-use benchmarks expose a fixed tool set or provide clear intermediate goals, which hides the difficulty of partial observability in real tool ecosystems. PlanBench-XL makes tool use retrieval-mediated: the agent must search for tools, use outputs to form new retrieval intents, and adapt when path-critical tools are missing, failing, or distracting. This helps diagnose whether failures come from planning, retrieval, evidence use, or tool invocation.","technical_approach":"The benchmark is an interactive retail-domain environment with 327 tasks and 1,665 tools. Each task requires about 25 turns on average. Agents do not receive the full tool inventory; they retrieve candidate tools from a large tool space at each step. The design supports bidirectional anticipation. Forward anticipation means searching from currently accumulated evidence toward the next useful action. Backward anticipation means reasoning from the desired final outcome to hypothesized intermediate states and tools. The environment includes default noisy tools whose descriptions or outputs may be irrelevant, stale, or erroneous. An optional blocking mode adds retrieval-time disruption by replacing or disabling path-critical tools while preserving at least one feasible solution path. The paper also describes a scalable LLM-based task generator that creates grounded user queries and paired tool ecosystems.","experiments":"The paper evaluates ten leading open and proprietary LLMs. Performance remains limited even without blocking: most models are below two-thirds accuracy in the default setting. The analysis suggests that successful agents need more than broad exploration. They must exploit discovered evidence precisely, invoke tools reliably, and detect when a current plan has become invalid. More retrieval alone is insufficient if the model cannot convert intermediate observations into the next useful search or re-plan after failure.","reading_guide":"Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Certifiable evaluation answers this question by providing guarantee for LLM evaluation. However, existing methods are not generally anytime-valid: the cla","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-06-18T18:07:42Z","category_id":"eval","cover_url":"/covers/2606_20820.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG"],"summary":{"core_problem":"CELEUS 解决的是顺序式 LLM 评测里的统计有效性问题：评测者一边抽样、一边更新置信区间，并可能在区间足够窄时停止；如果置信区间不是 anytime-valid，反复查看和自适应停止会破坏名义覆盖率。已有方法在实践中还会用已评测样本更新分层或采样策略，形成同一批数据既用于决策又用于不确定性估计的 double dipping。","importance":"对预训练研究的直接启发在评测侧。基座模型评测越来越依赖大规模题库、模型裁判、人类偏好和开放生成评分，单次固定样本评测很难兼顾成本和置信度。CELEUS 把顺序评测、主动选样和统计覆盖率放到同一个框架里，适合用于模型 checkpoint 选择、数据配比实验、训练中期能力追踪，以及昂贵评测集上的早停决策。贡献不在模型训练方法，而在让自适应评测的置信声明更可执行。","technical_approach":"方法核心是用 e-process 构造 anytime-valid 置信区间。e-process 的优点是对应用侧要求较弱，主要需要评分有界，通常可通过归一化或截断满足。难点在于评测样本不是均匀抽取，而是由不确定性引导采样；未评测样本还会用 surrogate score 近似。如果直接用观测风险，会对目标总体风险产生偏差。CELEUS 的处理是先构造 surrogate-completed 的有限池风险估计：已评测样本用真实风险，未评测样本用代理分数。新样本被选中并获得真实风险后，再加入 inverse-probability-weighted residual correction，即按被选概率校正该样本真实风险与代理分数的残差。这样得到的顺序信号在条件意义下对有限池风险无偏，随后通过 test inversion 得到 anytime-valid CI。对总体风险，方法再加一个 Hoeffding-style correction，把有限池结论提升到 population risk；当池子很大时该修正较小，小池子则可退化为全量评测。","experiments":"给定内容主要展示理论设计和有效性论证，而不是完整实验表格。可确认的结果包括：Theorem 3 给出条件无偏性，这是 e-process CI 成立的关键；Theorem 4 和 Theorem 5 分析 surrogate 分数与样本选择如何降低方差，并给出 oracle variance-optimal sampling rule，作为经验性 uncertainty-guided sampling 的依据；另有 anytime-valid 覆盖率证明。具体模型、数据集、样本节省比例和覆盖率数值在提供材料中不可核验。","reading_guide":"泛读建议用 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 里对 Cer-Eval 式做法的 double dipping 诊断，以及 Section 4 的信号构造和 Theorem 3。若只关心能否用于实际评测，直接看 surrogate-completed estimate、IPW residual correction、finite-pool 到 population 的 Hoeffding 修正。若关心成本节省，再看方差分析和采样规则。实验部分若有完整版本，优先检查两点：自适应停止后的真实覆盖率是否接近标称值；在同等 CI 宽度下能少评多少样本。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"CELEUS targets a statistical gap in sequential LLM evaluation. Evaluators often keep sampling, updating confidence intervals, and stopping once the interval is narrow enough. Standard fixed-time confidence intervals do not remain valid under repeated monitoring and adaptive stopping. Existing adaptive evaluation methods can also reuse the same evaluated data to update partitions or sampling rules and to quantify uncertainty, which creates a double-use problem.","importance":"The contribution is mainly on evaluation methodology, but it matters for pretraining workflows. Large model development increasingly relies on expensive open-ended evaluations, model-judge scores, human preference labels, and large item pools. A valid sequential evaluation procedure can support checkpoint selection, data-mixture comparisons, mid-training monitoring, and early stopping of costly evaluations without making overconfident claims.","technical_approach":"The framework builds anytime-valid confidence intervals through e-processes. The application-side assumption is mild: evaluation scores need to be bounded, which can usually be enforced by normalization or clipping. The main technical issue is bias under non-uniform adaptive sampling. CELEUS constructs a conditionally unbiased signal for the finite-pool risk. At each round, it forms a surrogate-completed estimate using observed scores for evaluated items and surrogate scores for unevaluated items. After an uncertainty-guided sampler selects a new item and its true score is observed, CELEUS adds an inverse-probability-weighted correction for the residual between the true score and the surrogate score. This corrected sequential signal enables e-process-based test inversion. A Hoeffding-style correction then lifts finite-pool intervals to population-risk intervals.","experiments":"The provided content primarily contains the framework and theoretical claims. They then study the matrix geometry. A rank sweep with Soft-Impute finds that held-out prediction error is minimized around rank 2. SVDs on the largest fully observed submatrices show that two factors explain more than 90% of the variance among models on shared benchmarks. 真正顺序不变。筛选后的各 facet 平均 flip rate 在 24% 到 50% 之间；即便是表现最好的模型，仍有 13.4% 的 trial 会因顺序变化而翻转答案。第二，能力强的模型通常更稳，文中给出 capability 与 flip rate 的 Spearman 相关约为 -0.95，但能力提升并不能消除这个问题，只能降低其频率。第三，模型自报置信度明显低估顺序风险，低估幅度达到 有一定效果，但高度依赖模态和任务，不具备统一迁移性。\n\n如果从全文里抓重点，建议特别关注各 facet 的差异，而不是只看总体 flip rate。因为 option-order、document-rank、image-set ordering 背后的机制并不一样，对训练改进的指向也不同。","reading_guide":"这篇更适合当评测方法论文来读。先看 Introduction Built upon PerceptionDLM-Base, a strong foundational baseline that achieves state-of-the-art performance am","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-06-17T19:27:55Z","category_id":"multimodal","cover_url":"/covers/2606_19534.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CV","cs.AI","cs.CL"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是一个很具体但有代表性的建模问题：多模态模型在区域感知任务上，往往需要对同一张图里的多个框或 mask 分别生成描述，而主流 AR MLLM 只能按“区域一个个来、token 一个个出”的方式解码，区域数一多，延迟和吞吐都会线性恶化。作者想验证的是，离散 diffusion language model 能否在保持较强视觉理解质量的同时，把多区域 captioning 改成一次并行去噪完成，从而把 DLM 的并行生成优势真正落到感知任务上，而不是只停留在通用文本生成层面。","importance":"对基座预训练研究的意义主要有两点。第一，它把 diffusion LM 从“能不能做多模态”推进到“在哪类任务上比 AR 更合适”，给出了一个较清楚的适用场景：当输出天然由多个相对独立但又共享图像上下文的片段组成时，非自回归并行生成有结构性优势。第二，它不是只做推理技巧，而是围绕建模目标、输入组织方式、注意力结构和评测协议一起设计，这对研究 AR 之外的新语言建模范式很有参考价值。它未必说明 DLM 会全面替代 AR MLLM，但说明在 region-level perception 这类任务上，AR 的顺序约束可能是多余的，甚至是主要瓶颈。","technical_approach":"方法分两层：先做一个更强的 diffusion VLM 基线，再在其上加入并行区域感知机制。\n\n第一层是 PerceptionDLM-Base。它沿用离散 diffusion language modeling 的基本形式：把文本 token 在前向过程中逐步替换成 [MASK] 之类的吸收态，训练模型在给定 x_t 的条件下恢复原始 token x_0，损失只算被 mask 的位置。多模态部分则是把预训练视觉编码器接到 diffusion language backbone 上，通过 visual instruction tuning 学会根据图像和指令做文本去噪生成。作者把这部分定位成一个更强的 open discrete diffusion VLM baseline，目的是先把“扩散式多模态模型本身太弱”这个问题压下去，否则后面的并行区域机制没有比较基础。\n\n第二层是区域并行机制。核心思想不是把多个区域简单拼成更长 prompt，而是显式告诉模型“哪些 token 属于哪个区域描述”，并限制不同区域生成时的相互干扰。具体看，作者引入了 region-aware mask embeddings，让不同区域对应的被 mask 文本槽位带有区域身份；同时设计 structured attention masking，使每个区域描述在解码时既能访问共享的图像与指令上下文，又不会无约束地串扰到其他区域的文本内容。这样做的原因很直接：如果完全共享文本上下文，多个区域描述容易互相污染；如果完全隔离，又会损失图像级共享语义和指令条件。结构化注意力是在这两者之间取平衡。\n\n从建模角度看，这个方案利用了 DLM 的两个性质。其一，token 级并行去噪允许多个区域的文本槽位同时更新，而不需要像 AR 那样为每个区域单独跑一遍解码。其二，扩散过程天然适合“部分已知、部分待填”的条件生成，区域提示、mask 和图像特征可以统一进同一个 denoising 框架。作者还提出 ParaDLC-Bench，把原本单区域的 DLC-Bench 扩展成并发多区域评测，既看 caption 质量，也看效率。这一点很重要，因为如果只看准确率，很难体现 DLM 相对 AR 的真正收益。","experiments":"实验结果主要支持两个结论：基线质量够强，并行区域机制确实带来效率收益且质量可接受。\n\n1. PerceptionDLM-Base 作为 diffusion VLM 基线并不弱。作者在 16 个多模态 benchmark 上比较，称其在 15/16 个任务上优于 LLaDA-V。这说明后续区域并行结果不是建立在一个明显偏弱的 DLM 底座上。\n\n2. 在新提出的 ParaDLC-Bench 上，并行区域 captioning 的质量明显好于现有 diffusion 基线。PerceptionDLM 平均准确率 62.4%，而 LLaDA-V 只有 35.2%，接近翻倍。这里的提升说明仅仅把通用 diffusion VLM 直接拿来做多区域感知是不够的，区域身份建模和结构化注意力是有效的。\n\n3. 与强 AR 区域模型相比，作者给出的结论是“质量接近但效率更好”。摘要和正文前部强调，在模型规模可比的条件下，随着查询区域数增加，PerceptionDLM 避免了 AR 模型近似线性的延迟增长；在稠密感知场景，例如每张图 5 个 mask 时，吞吐最高可提升 3.5 倍。这个结果符合任务结构：AR 需要为每个区域、每个 token 顺序展开，而 DLM 可以把多个区域的 token 槽位放进同一轮或同一组 denoising steps。\n\n4. 从吞吐曲线描述看，作者还专门分析了 region quantity 增长和 constant workload 下的 scaling。虽然这里没有看到全文后半段更细的表格数字，但从引言给出的结论可以推断，PerceptionDLM 的优势不是单点速度，而是区域数上来后增长更平缓。这比单次 latency 更有意义，因为它说明并行化收益来自建模范式，而不是某个工程 trick。\n\n如果从局限看，这篇工作暂时更像“在特定输出结构上证明 diffusion MLLM 的适配性”，而不是证明 DLM 在通用多模态生成上全面优于 AR。区域描述之间仍可能存在依赖，结构化注意力如何在共享上下文与去串扰之间取最优平衡，应该是后续要继续看的点。","reading_guide":"泛读建议先看三部分。第一，看 PerceptionDLM-Base 的架构图和训练目标，确认它与 LLaDA-V 这类离散 diffusion VLM 的差别主要在哪里。第二，看 region-aware mask embeddings 和 structured attention masking 的示意图，这是全文真正的方法增量。第三，看 ParaDLC-Bench 的定义和 throughput 对 region 数量的曲线，因为这决定了作者是否真的证明了“并行区域感知”而不是只做了一个新 benchmark 上的小幅提分。\n\n如果只花 25 分钟左右，建议顺序是：Introduction 中关于 AR 瓶颈和任务设定的动机；PerceptionDLM-Base 小节；并行区域机制小节；ParaDLC-Bench 评测协议；最后看主结果表和 throughput 图。阅读时重点关注两个问题：为什么结构化注意力是必要的，而不是简单把多个区域 prompt 拼接起来；以及 3.5x 吞吐提升是在什么区域数、什么比较基线、什么模型规模下得到的。做 diffusion LM 或 unified multimodal pretraining 的人，值得把它当成一个“DLM 在何处比 AR 更自然”的案例来读。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper targets a specific but important modeling gap in multimodal systems: region-level perception often requires describing multiple boxes or masks from the same image, yet most MLLMs still decode in a fully autoregressive way, region by region and token by token. r","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-06-17T20:39:04Z","category_id":"multimodal","cover_url":"/covers/2606_19584.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CV"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作要解决的不是传统 VLM 的“看图再交给大语言模型解释”，而是更前面的一步：能不能把语言指令直接注入视觉编码器，让视觉表征在推理时按任务动态变化。现有视觉基础模型大多输出静态 embedding，后续问“颜色”“类别”“关系”“是否异常”都只能依赖下游 LLM 在固定视觉特征上做二次推理。一旦视觉编码阶段没有保留某些细粒度信息，后面的 LLM 再大也补不回来，常见表现就是视觉幻觉和任务不受控。LIVE 的核心问题因此很明确：如何训练一个可被自然语言指令调制的视觉编码器，使其在零样本条件下直接产出面向当前任务的视觉 embedding，而不是把任务适配压力全部留给下游语言模型。","importance":"对基座研究的意义主要在两点。第一，它提出了一种“把语言知识蒸馏回视觉编码器”的路线，和主流“冻结视觉塔 + 扩大后端 LLM”形成了清楚对照。这对原生多模态预训练有启发，因为它讨论的是表示学习阶段的控制能力，而不是单纯靠更大的解码器兜底。第二，它把合成指令数据、对比式对齐目标、语言条件视觉编码三者连成了一个可操作 recipe，说明任务条件化表征可以在 encoder 侧学出来，并且能在不依赖大 LLM 推理的情况下改善泛化和幻觉。量级上，这不是通用 LLM 预训练范式的改写，但对 VLM 预训练、视觉 T(q))，让图像编码过程显式依赖指令语义。训练目标不是生成答案，而是让“图像 + 指令”得到的视觉 embedding 对齐到正确答案的文本 embedding。也就是说，模型学的是一种任务定向的表征空间：给定同一张图，不同指令会把视觉表示拉向不同答案语义。\n\n训练数据来自合成 triplet：图像、指令、答案。论文用 LLM 作为知识源，在 ImageNet 类图像上生成 instruction-response 对，再与图像组成训练样本。这个设计有两个关键点。其一，监督信号不是配对 caption，而是真正带任务意图的 instruction，因此比“图像描述对齐”更接近下游问答和感知控制。其二，答案仍落在文本编码器空间里，因此训练可以继续使用成熟的对比式对齐框架，而不必引入复杂生成头。\n\n损失函数采用 SigLIP 风格的 sigmoid alignment loss，而不是 CLIP 常见的 softmax 对比损失。文中给出的理由是稳定性和效果更好，尤其适合批内正负样本匹配。训练时只优化语言条件视觉编码器，文本编码器作为语义锚点复用。推理时不需要大语言模型，只需输入图像和指令，就能得到任务相关 embedding，后续可直接用于分类、检索、问答匹配等。\n\n从机制上看，这个方法和 Flamingo/LLaVA 一类架构的区别很清楚：后者把语言理解和任务适配主要放在大解码器里，视觉塔多半仍是通用静态特征提取器；LIVE 则把任务控制前移到视觉编码阶段。它也不同于 caption-conditioned 视觉调制工作，因为这里的文本不是描述图像内容，而是指定“该关注什么”。这使它更接近 instruction-following，而不是 image-text matching h","starred":false,"priority":"p3","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-06-22T19:30:30Z","category_id":"multimodal","cover_url":"/covers/2606_23885.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CV","cs.AI","cs.CL","cs.MM"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇论文要解决的是 Alignment。核心流程有三步。第一，用外部 teacher vision encoder 提取图像表示，用语言模型内部不同 attention head 的表示作为候选语言侧表示。第二，用 Mutual K-Nearest Neighbor, MKNN, 衡量两侧表示的局部邻域是否一致。MKNN 不比较绝对坐标，而比较一个样本在两个表征空间里的近邻集合是否相互匹配。第三，不是选择最已经对齐的 评测结果。若只关心预训练启发，可以跳过常规 VQA 榜单细节，把注意力放在“在已有 LLM 组织结构上施加跨模态约束”的设计取舍。这个方向值得深挖的问题是：head-level 拓扑对齐是否能扩展到更早期的 native multimodal pretraining，而不是只在 LLaVA state of the language backbone to an external vision encoder. This ignores the fact that Transformer representations are organized unevenly across attention heads. The paper asks whether visual-language alignment can be improved by targeting the specific heads whose local geometry is poorly aligned with the visual teacher.","importance":"Its main relevance is to multimodal pretraining and adaptation rather than text-only LM pretraining. The useful idea is to align topology instead of raw features. In an MLLM built on a pretrained LLM, forcing hidden states to match a vision encoder coordinate-by-coordinate can interfere with the language model’s existing structure. Preserving local neighborhood relations is a softer constraint and may be a better fit for improving perception while retaining language behavior. The contribution is a focused methodological improvement, with a clear diagnostic-and-training loop.","technical_approach":"HeRA, or Head-Wise Representation Alignment, first measures alignment between individual attention-head representations and a teacher vision encoder using Mutual K-Nearest Neighbor alignment. MKNN compares whether samples share similar local neighborhoods in the two representation spaces, rather than comparing vector coordinates directly. HeRA then selects the least aligned heads and applies a contrastive alignment loss to them, alongside the standard autoregressive token likelihood. The choice of least aligned heads is important: already aligned heads are likely to offer limited gain and stronger risk of disrupting useful structure, while poorly aligned heads are plausible bottlenecks for cross-modal reasoning. Compared with fixed-layer alignment or direct feature regression, the method is more fine-grained and less rigid.","experiments":"The experiments are conducted under the LLaVA-style MLLM framework across multiple model variants and 18 vision-language benchmarks. The reported pattern is consistent improvement on visually demanding tasks, including object presence, counting, spatial relation understanding, and dense visual parsing. General VQA performance is not degraded and often improves. The paper also reports reduced visual hallucination, which is consistent with the view that topological alignment weakens over-reliance on language priors. The full paper argues that the missing variable is the degree of off-policyness induced by rollout reuse. In GRPO-style training, updates are shaped by importance-sampling ratios and clipping. In visual math, a sample must be image-grounded, mathematically valid, and verifiable. If incorrect labels enter RL, the noise is not a passive annotation issue anymore; it is repeatedly converted into optimization pressure and can reinforce the wrong policy. The paper therefore reframes scaling as a verifiable data-construction problem. Before any policy update, it separates two axes that are usually entangled: prompt difficulty is expanded through structured evolution, while answer reliability is enforced through offline falsification-based verification.","importance":"This matters at the pretrain–posttrain interface. Many reasoning papers spend most of their effort on the optimizer side—sampling, GRPO variants, advantage shaping—while assuming the answer labels are already trustworthy. This work argues that for reasoning-heavy multimodal training, reward quality is itself a first-order systems problem. Its main contribution is not a new RL algorithm, but a data pipeline that makes verification modular, auditable, and scalable. That is useful beyond visual math: the same design logic is relevant to synthetic reasoning corpora, code verification, math supervision, and any setting where noisy labels can be amplified by RL. If a continuous reward model imposes a strict ordering within that equivalence set, RL will optimize those arbitrary differences as if they were real utility. For researchers working on RL-based agent training, RL pretraining, or environment-interaction mid-training, the main lesson is that trajectories can be lifted into a state-transition graph, and the training signal can be computed on that graph rather than on individual rollouts.","technical_approach":"G2PO reconstructs sampled agent trajectories into a directed state-transition graph. Identical or similar observations are grouped into state groups, and actions become edges between source and destination states. State value is estimated by aggregating outcomes over all states in the same group, instead of relying on one trajectory’s terminal reward. Action advantage is then computed from the value increment across an edge, which resembles a one-step TD error in sparse-reward tasks. Unlike local group methods such as GiGPO, which compare actions only within the same state, G2PO normalizes edge-level TD errors against a global reference group containing transitions from the whole graph. This gives more weight to transitions that make large absolute progress toward task success.","experiments":"The evaluation uses WebShop, ALFWorld, and AppWorld with Qwen-2.5 models at 1.5B, 7B, and 14B scale. AppWorld is used to test the method under more complex observations. The key implication is that reasoning ability depends not only on the quality of a single chain of thought, but also on whether the model has learned the topology of inference compute: sequential thinking, parallel exploration, and cross-trace aggregation. It exposes the model to three forms of inference compute during training: sequential compute inside one trace, parallel compute across independently sampled traces, and aggregative compute that synthesizes a set of traces into a final output. Aggregation traces can be optimized with standard RL algorithms such as GRPO because they generate a final answer that receives a reward. Parallel traces require a different credit assignment scheme: an individual trace may be wrong, but still contain an idea that helps the aggregator solve the problem. SPIRAL uses set reinforcement learning, where a set of generations from the same prompt receives a joint learning signal. A low-variance marginal advantage is then used to assign credit to individual traces under the set-level objective. This differs from standard GRPO, which optimizes the relative advantage of individual responses rather than the utility of a candidate set plus an aggregator.","experiments":"The paper fine-tunes Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on mathematical reasoning and compares SPIRAL against GRPO under an equal training compute budget. Forward KL is teacher-weighted and is less sensitive to stale student rollouts under a finite teacher cache. Reverse KL is student-weighted and becomes fragile when the current student assigns probability to actions that were not scored by the teacher in the stale cache. The paper then treats reverse-KL OPD through a policy-gradient-style surrogate, where the teacher-student log-ratio acts as a token-level advantage. It evaluates PPO-style clipping, decoupled PPO, and M2PO, but finds that a simpler OPD-specific surrogate works better: recompute the reverse-KL token advantage at learner time under the current student, without clipping. The estimator study shows the limitation of stale top-k supports, the high variance of one-sample MC, and the more favorable tradeoff of multi-sample MC. When student rollouts are reused across multiple optimization epochs, the current student can drift away from the behavior student that generated those trajectories. This creates a mismatch even if teacher supervision is unchanged: some sampled positions become stale for the current update. Prior work has mostly focused on teacher-side reliability, such as the fragility of sampled-token OPD and the repair provided by Teacher-TopK or local support matching. This paper targets a different failure mode: old-current student drift under rollout reuse.","importance":"The contribution is not directly about pretraining, but it matters for the pretrain-to-post-train interface. The paper’s value is its restraint: it does not introduce a new teacher objective or a new rollout policy. Instead, it adds a lightweight loss reweighting rule based only on the student’s own old-versus-current log-probability shift. outlier”这个解释转成了一个可被架构干预直接证伪的命题。","experiments":"实验规模不大，但控制做得比较干净。作者在 160M 和 290M 两个语言模型规模上做 matched-loss 对比，也就是先把 Ledger Residuals 与标准 Transformer 训练到可比损失，再比较激活结构，而不是拿性能差异混淆机制结论。主要发现有三点。第一，protected decode-only commitment channel 并没有消除 massive activations。模型会在 C 中重新形成熟悉的固定维度 outlier，并且仍然高度集中在 sequence-start token。第二，这个重建出来的 outlier 幅度比标准 Transformer 小一些，但空间和位置上的集中性更强，说明“变小”不等于“消失”，更像是模型在新约束下重新编码同一功能。第三，显式的 commit-sparsity penalty 会适得其反。作者给出的数字是，随着更强的稀疏提交约束，dominant-dimension persistence 从 0.58 升到 0.96，start-token concentration 从 3.4 升到 4.7。也就是说，模型不是减少对 outlier 维度的依赖，而是把它做得更稳定、更集中。摘要和正文还提到，massive activations 通常在前几层形成，并在后续层中近似保持常数，这一经典现象在新架构下仍然保留了核心形态。论文的重点不是 benchmark 分数，而是这些结构性测量：最大维度幅值、固定维度持久性、对起始 token 的集中度，以及在 matched-loss 条件下与标准架构的对照。","reading_guide":"泛读建议是先看 Introduction，把作者要检验的两个对立解释理清：artifact 还是 function。然后直接看 Section 3 的 Ledger Residuals 设计和 Figure 1，理解 D/C 两条流分别承担什么职责，以及它为何能作为受控干预。接着看 Section 5 outlier。答案是会。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper asks a mechanistic question about transformers: are massive activations merely an architectural artifact caused by overloading Instead of adding another correlational argument, the authors perform a direct architectural intervention. earlier mistake in the conversation history, it can get trapped into repeatedly following that bad trajectory. The authors call this pigeonholing. The problem is not merely prompt sensitivity in a single turn; it is the inability to recover under contaminated context. They focus on two realistic settings: the user suggests an incorrect answer, or the assistant made an earlier mistake that the user failed to correct. The central question is why dialogue history can progressively narrow the model’s solution space and how to train models to recover from such polluted contexts.","importance":"For foundation-model research, the contribution is mainly conceptual and training-oriented. paper targets a very specific failure-analysis question: within a generated reasoning trace, which exact token causes the trajectory to shift from still-recoverable to likely-failing. Prior work usually operates at step, chunk, or sentence granularity, or marks positions after failure has already materialized. That misses the actual trigger. The authors define a cliff token as the token where token-wise potential—the probability of eventually reaching the correct answer given the current prefix—drops significantly. The technical challenge is to identify such triggers reliably under noisy rollout estimates, rather than mistaking sampling variance for a real collapse in reasoning quality.","importance":"Its value is less about introducing a new training paradigm and more about providing a sharper unit of analysis for reasoning failures. The key nuance is that not all failure tokens are equally learnable: uncertain and sampled-off cliffs respond to token-level preference training, while deterministic cliffs largely do not. interpretability work: if a behavior is linearly detectable in the residual stream, then the same direction, or a nearby one, should also be able to causally steer that behavior. The authors turn this into a geometric question by measuring the angle between a detection direction and an intervention direction. The main result is that this assumption only holds for some surface behaviors, such as output formatting, but breaks for hallucination. In hallucination settings, the model can linearly separate real vs non-existent entities extremely early and almost perfectly, yet that signal is nearly orthogonal to the direction that actually induces refusal.","importance":"This is not a pretraining recipe paper, but it matters for pretraining research because it separates representational availability from controllable mechanism. The gap is stable across model families, scales, and even before vs after instruction tuning. The Gemma 2-2B base and instruct models show almost identical cosine values (0.1197 vs 0.1200), which strongly suggests that the geometry is already laid down during pretraining. That has a concrete implication for the pretrain/post-train interface: a probe can read out knowledge from pretrained activations, but that does not mean the pretrained model has organized that knowledge along a low-cost causal control axis. Post-training may be adding a policy channel on top of knowledge representations rather than simply amplifying an existing “truth direction.”","technical_approach":"$f2","experiments":"$f3","reading_guide":"For a skim, focus on three parts. This scheme suffers from a readout blind spot: the loss only supervises state dimensions exposed by the readout head, and fails to constrain variables actively propagated along the recurrent path but hidden by normalized readouts. The most salient failure mode is unconstrained drift of hidden state radial scale (RMS norm) across loops.","importance":"This work identifies a fundamental design gap in dense supervision for looped LMs, showing that per-loop cross-entropy only guarantees usable early exits but does not automatically stabilize recurrent state dynamics. Two categories of fixes are validated: either expose scale to the loss (raw readouts without normalization, explicit norm penalties), or remove scale from the recurrent path (in-loop normalization, explicit scale clamps).","experiments":"Experiments on 44M and 129M parameter looped transformers for language modeling show: (1) Unmodified baselines with per-loop cross-entropy and normalized readouts exhibit hidden state RMS drift of multiple orders of magnitude across loops; (2) Scale-controlled variants achieve lower perplexity at matched inference compute budgets compared to RMSNorm readout baselines, while retaining functional early exits, improving the perplexity-compute Pareto frontier for variable-depth inference.","reading_guide":"Skim the paper, focusing on the mechanism derivation in Section 2, the visibility-activity mismatch schematic in Figure 2, and the intervention experiments and perplexity-compute curves in Section 5 to grasp the core mismatch logic. bloat}","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-06-19T06:35:52Z","category_id":"agent","cover_url":"/covers/2606_21144.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CL","cs.AI"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作讨论的不是“怎样存更多记忆”，而是“在长期个性化交互里，什么值得被写进记忆”。作者认为现有 LLM memory agent 大多默认一个统一写入规则：只要对话里出现事实，就尽量提取并保存。这个假设在短任务里问题不大，但在真实长周期场景里会导致 memory bloat：无关细节不断累积，占用检索预算和上下文窗口，最终让真正重要的信息更难被召回。更关键的是，记忆价值是角色相关、用户相关的。同一句对话，对商务助理和健身伙伴的重要性完全不同。AdaMem 试图解决的核心问题，就是如何让记忆写入策略从“尽量全记”变成“按用户偏好有选择地记”，并且能从反馈中持续修正。","importance":"对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train memory system 和 agent training interface 有现实意义。它把长期记忆问题从 retrieval 侧往前推了一步，强调 write control 才是部署瓶颈。这个视角很重要，因为很多记忆系统把主要精力放在更强的检索器或更长的上下文，却默认写入阶段是无害的；AdaMem 说明如果写入策略错了，后面再强的检索也只是在噪声里找答案。对基座研究员而言，启发主要有两点。第一，长期记忆不只是压缩问题，也是偏好建模问题；“什么该保留”本身需要学习。第二，反馈闭环可以不直接更新主模型，而是更新一个外部 memory policy，这是一种比全量 RL 或 continual finetuning 更轻的适配路径。它更像 memory management 层的方法，而不是新的语言建模范式。","technical_approach":"AdaMem 的核心对象是一个结构化 Memory Policy。它用 JSON 形式为每个角色 C_i 指定一段自然语言偏好描述 T_i，例如只保留业务决策和 deadline，忽略日常寒暄。整个系统按周循环，包含四步。\n\n第一步是 Daily Extraction。每天对新对话做记忆抽取时，不再使用统一 prompt，而是把当前 policy 渲染成定制化抽取指令，让 extractor LLM 按角色偏好决定写入内容。作者还加入了 Time Anchoring：在抽取 prompt 中显式提供会话绝对日期，要求模型把“明天”“下周三”这类相对时间解析成绝对日期再存储，避免长期记忆里时间语义漂移。\n\n第二步是 Weekly Evaluation。每周末用针对偏好相关信息构造的 QA 来测试系统，观察哪些问题答错。\n\n第三步是 Policy Reflection。系统分析错误来源，将失败分成两类：Recall Failure，说明对话里有信息但没被写入，当前 policy 太保守；Precision Failure，说明检索出的无关记忆干扰了回答，当前 policy 太宽松。基于这些错误，模型生成一个 patch ΔP_t 去修改 policy，而不是重写整套规则。patch-style 更新的好处是局部、可追踪，也更适合失败回滚。\n\n第四步是 Failure Rollback 和 Policy Rendering。如果新 policy 在历史验证 QA 上表现变差，就拒绝这次更新并回滚，防止 policy drift。通过这种闭环，AdaMem 试图把 memory extraction 从一次性 prompt engineering 变成持续校正的控制过程。\n\n方法上最有意思的地方不是模型结构，而是把长期记忆系统拆成了“写入策略—反馈诊断—局部修补—回滚保护”这条控制链。它没有训练新的大型记忆模块，也不依赖复杂 agent
